name: MQTT.js
solves: Provides a full-featured MQTT client for Node.js and browsers to publish/subscribe over MQTT 3.1/5.0, enabling IoT and event-bus style messaging with QoS, retained messages, and broker interoperability.
best_for: IoT and device fleets that speak MQTT to brokers (Mosquitto, HiveMQ, AWS IoT)
Event-driven systems using pub/sub topics with QoS and retained messages
Browser or Node clients that must interoperate with existing MQTT infrastructure
Telemetry pipelines where MQTT is the organizational standard
Bridging devices to cloud IoT platforms via MQTT.js
skip_when: You are building browser collaborative docs — use Yjs/Liveblocks/Socket.IO instead
You need a managed WebSocket pub/sub UX for web apps (Pusher/Ably)
You only need raw WebSockets without MQTT protocol semantics
Your environment blocks MQTT ports and you lack a WebSocket MQTT bridge
Application-level rooms/namespaces of Socket.IO fit better than topic hierarchies

hosted_alternative.name: Ably
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier with message limits; paid plans scale with messages and connections
